card.name: Packaging words in supply descriptions
card.fires_on: Mostly the word package or packaged (also packages) in 'available packaged as' or 'pharmacy bulk package' in how-supplied text. Weaker hits on 'companies' after a number and 'Moore' in the paint brand Benjamin Moore.

modes.label: Package wording
modes.description: The word package or packaged describing how a product is supplied.
modes.example: AHZANTIVE is available<< packaged>> as follows: Pre-filled Syringe.

modes.label: Pharmacy bulk package
modes.description: The word package ending the phrase 'pharmacy bulk package'.
modes.example: PROSOL is supplied as a pharmacy bulk<< package>> for admixing only

modes.label: Other nouns
modes.description: Scattered hits on a company noun or the brand name Moore.
